definitions: A cloud computing execution model where the cloud provider dynamically manages the allocation and provisioning of servers, allowing users to run inference tasks (making predictions from a trained machine learning model) without explicitly managing server infrastructure.
The process of deploying and executing machine learning models for prediction or classification in a serverless environment, abstracting away the underlying infrastructure management.
examples: Many companies are adopting Serverless Inference for cost efficiency.
Scalability is a key benefit of Serverless Inference.
Implementing Serverless Inference can simplify MLOps workflows.
